name: TreePeople Volunteer Events (all ages with parent consent)
what_you_do: Sign up for tree planting and other volunteer events. They are listed on the TreePeople events calendar.
who_can_apply: No age limit. Minors need a signed parental consent form. Volunteers 15 and under (the FAQ says under 15) need an adult chaperone age 21 or older, one adult per 10 young volunteers.
duration: Single events; calendar posted at least a month ahead
deadline_text: Sign up for each event on the Events Calendar. No program deadline.
how_to_apply: Sign up for an event on the TreePeople events calendar. The confirmation email has the waiver and parent consent forms. Groups must email volunteer@treepeople.org first.
notes: TreePeople's jobs page lists only an 18+ fellowship, so this is the way in for teens. The page gives two versions of the chaperone age rule (15 and under vs under 15), so confirm by email.
